_comment: Which spoken phrase each moment on the page lands on. `cue` is a wire id: the slide id, a colon,
then the local name the page writes, so data-in="title" inside <template data-slide="1.1"> is
1.1:title. `on` is a word or short phrase from that section of script.md, matched ignoring case
and punctuation. `occurrence` picks which match, counting from 1. `$start` is the section start
and `$end` is the end of speech, and `offset` shifts a cue in seconds.
`decktalk check` names every moment this file has no row for, and offers the row as a fix.
